text:
sre-bot: :rotating_light: Pager: inference-serving high-latency spike detected in us-west-2. Incident INC-2026-042. Trigger: request queue growth > 95%.
Sara: I'm oncall, joining bridge now — starting mitigation.
Devon: handoff received. I'll pull recent autoscaler events and kernel OOM logs.
ops-bot: Bridge created <https://zoom.example.com/meet/INC-2026-042|join here> • Log collection started by syslog-collector.
Mike: temporary mitigation: reduced batch_size from 32 -> 8 and scaled pool +2 replicas via k8s.
Sara: applied change at 2026-04-12T03:22:11Z, latency median dropped 1200ms -> 220ms within 90s :white_check_mark:
Anya: for customer impact: notifying CSMs, can we add a status page banner? @CSM please confirm.
CSM: emailed top-k accounts, only Acme reported visible slowdowns (~5m elevated latency). No errors reported in payloads.
Sara: good. I'll book a postmortem slot tomorrow 11:00 PT. RCA owners: @Devon (lead), @Sara (ops timeline).
Devon: starting draft of timeline and evidence. Pinging infra: @Mike, can you attach autoscaler metrics and kube events?
Mike: attaching logs in thread — snippet:
```
2026-04-12T03:20:59Z autoscaler: scaleDownBlocked=true reason=ongoingRollout
2026-04-12T03:21:05Z pod/inference-7 evicted reason=MemoryPressure
2026-04-12T03:22:11Z config change: batch_size=8
```
Devon: preliminary contributing factors: 1) autoscaler mis-evaluated pending pods during rollout, 2) burst traffic pattern + large default batch sizes, 3) insufficient early-warning SLO alerts.
Anya: Suggest adding an action: runbook entry + automated rollback if batch_size > 16 during high queue length.
Legal: quick check — any PII or key leakage observed? Ops says no. Please preserve logs for 90 days as evidence.
Sara: noted. Draft timeline (WIP):
```
03:19:45Z - Spike begins, request queue growth
03:20:30Z - Pager fired (threshold breach)
03:20:59Z - Autoscaler event: rollout detected
03:21:05Z - Pod eviction due to MemoryPressure
03:22:11Z - Mitigation applied (batch_size -> 8)
03:23:40Z - Latency normalized
03:30:00Z - Bridge closed
```
Devon: asking peers for review: @Anya @Mike @Legal please review draft by EOD. We'll consolidate comments and aim for RCA sign-off by Friday.
Anya: will review. Action items I propose:
- AI-001: Add autoscaler unit test for rollout edge-case (owner: Mike)
- AI-002: Add runbook section for batch_size rollback (owner: Sara)
- AI-003: Improve SLO alerting sensitivity for queue growth (owner: DevOps)
Sara: I've created a tracking ticket in our board: INF-5423 and linked this thread. Please add estimates in comments.
Mike: ack, will slot AI-001 in next sprint. ETA for fix: 2 weeks.
Devon: once peer review done, I'll produce RCA draft and tag Engineering Lead for sign-off. Thanks everyone.
sre-bot: Incident closed: mitigated -> postmortem scheduled. Reminder: attach artifacts (heap dumps, kernel logs, autoscaler metrics) to INF-5423.
Sara: closing with owners assigned. :heavy_check_mark:
